summary: Describes ingress filtering mechanisms and their generic issues, with particular attention to the effects on multihomed networks. BCP 38, RFC 2827, limits the impact of DDoS attacks by denying traffic with spoofed addresses. This best current practice updates RFC 2827.

eli5.summary: A guard at a school gate checks that arriving kids really come from the school they claim. This explains how that check works when a network has more than one gate.

questions: how to filter spoofed addresses with multiple isps
